_note: More ways to find Hill jobs: programs and job boards that are not single employers. Shown at the bottom of the Employers tab. sourceUrl is internal (never shown). Evidence and the maybe/skip list are in data/PROGRAMS-REVIEW.md.

programs.name: Pathways jobs for students (USAJOBS)
programs.who: Current students looking for paid federal internships and trainee jobs at Hill

programs.name: Pathways jobs for recent graduates (USAJOBS)
programs.who: People who finished a degree or certificate in the last 2 years (6 for veterans)

programs.name: DoD SkillBridge
programs.who: Service members in their last 180 days: internships with civilian employers (pick Utah)

programs.name: Utah Aerospace Pathway
programs.who: High school juniors and seniors: aerospace manufacturing certificate and guaranteed interviews

programs.name: ClearanceJobs: Hill AFB, UT
programs.who: People with (or able to get) a security clearance looking for contractor jobs at Hill

programs.name: Ogden-Weber Tech job board
programs.who: OTECH students and grads; public listings include trades jobs near Hill
